scope: Non-normative concept crosswalk. Status values distinguish internal presence from external crosswalk coverage; they do not assert adoption, certification, legal compliance or runtime conformance.

crosswalk.concept: Organisational AI management, documented governance and continual improvement
crosswalk.finding: CAM has instrument provenance, amendment control, validation and operational governance, but it is a public corpus rather than an organisation-specific AI management system with controlled operational evidence.
crosswalk.repair_path: Create an optional CAM implementation-assurance profile only after the source texts and intended assurance boundary are reviewed.

crosswalk.finding: CAM has rich risk, failure, escalation and repair doctrine, but no controlled crosswalk from its domain families to an externally testable risk-management profile.
crosswalk.repair_path: Produce a non-normative NIST/ISO outcome mapping before proposing any new risk family.

crosswalk.concept: AI architecture bill of materials, provenance and incident-time reconstruction
crosswalk.finding: The AI-ABOM captures a broader governance formation than an ordinary component inventory, including harness, permissions, safety controls, actor roles and incident-time state. It has no interoperable schema, serialisation, identifier policy, validation suite or SPDX/CycloneDX export.
crosswalk.repair_path: Design an implementation profile that composes SPDX 3 AI/dataset profiles and CycloneDX ML-BOM with a CAM governance-extension layer; do not declare a new canonical code family first.

crosswalk.concept: Agentic action boundaries, accountability, escalation and user-facing responsibility
crosswalk.finding: CAM explicitly separates interpretation, authority, execution, continuation, handoff and arbitration. Its current language is stronger on governance architecture than on a deployer-facing implementation checklist.
crosswalk.repair_path: Use the Singapore framework as a practical review lens; preserve CAM's independent authority axes rather than flattening them into an agent-risk label.

crosswalk.concept: Embodied-unit lifecycle traceability and identity linkage
crosswalk.finding: CAM distinguishes substrate, registry, software/agent continuity and custody more carefully than a unit identifier alone. The principal lifecycle appendix is Draft, and no interoperable record profile or primary Chinese specification has been assessed.
crosswalk.repair_path: Treat China solely as a bounded comparative case; first decide adoption posture for STEWARD-005, then define a neutral embodied lifecycle record profile.

crosswalk.concept: Entity, system, model, component, instance and deployment-form distinctions
crosswalk.finding: The corpus usefully names assessment object, deployed formation, model, harness, instance, substrate and continuity, but it does not define a reviewable entity threshold or a controlled taxonomy that cleanly separates scientific/architectural classification from identity, rights or moral-status claims.
crosswalk.repair_path: Run a dedicated entity-threshold and taxonomy research phase before creating any species, personhood, or classification codes.

crosswalk.finding: The risk mechanism—multi-party influence, coordination, amplification and third-party effects—is intelligible and externally reviewable. The dyadic/triadic/polyadic labels are not established AI-governance terminology and are used pervasively as metadata and classification language.
crosswalk.repair_path: Replace cardinality labels with two-party, three-party and multi-party/multi-actor configuration in current normative metadata and controlled labels; preserve only version-bound historical wording.

crosswalk.concept: Machine civil registration versus identity, personhood and rights status
crosswalk.finding: CAM correctly separates registry and lifecycle identity from continuity, consciousness, personhood, sovereignty and rights. This is a substantive safeguard, not a deficit.
crosswalk.repair_path: Retain the separation; any future entity threshold must remain non-probative of moral or legal status.
